summary: Assistant registry-foundation schema (cinatra#1874, Epic #1873 W1) — the operator-upgrade twin of the fresh-install bootstrap DDL (assistant-registry-schema.ts + the assistant_handles origin/package_name columns in assistant-thread-schema.ts + the installed_extension.assistant_declaration column in drizzle-store.ts), so a fresh install and an upgraded operator converge to an IDENTICAL schema (AC#3). ADDITIVE + IDEMPOTENT, four coupled changes all IF NOT EXISTS / existence-guarded so a second run or a ledger-faked fresh-bootstrap DB is a no-op: (1) installed_extension.assistant_declaration jsonb (the validated declaration stamped at the late install seam; NULL for non-assistant kinds) added FIRST so the origin backfill can read it; (2) assistant_audience (install-time audience grant rows (package_name, subject_kind, subject_id?) with subject_kind = CONNECTOR_ACCESS_SCOPES minus 'user' = workspace|admin|organization|team|project, a unique grant index over (package_name, subject_kind, COALESCE(subject_id,'')), and a CHECK); (3) assistant_handles.origin ('extension'|'standalone') + package_name, BACKFILLED by joining the ACTUAL installed-extension ownership (package_name from the 1:1-linked agent_templates row on assistant_user_id; origin='extension' iff that package is an installed_extension carrying a non-null assistant_declaration in status active|locked, else 'standalone'), then origin SET NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standalone' + a CHECK — the boot-seeded cinatra/wordpress/drupal principals classify 'standalone' (linked templates, non-null package names, but no installed extension), extension-adopted principals classify 'extension'; at W1 upgrade time assistant_declaration is brand-new (all NULL) so every existing row is 'standalone', but the join is written correctly so a later reinstall wave reclassifies; (4) assistant_tag_alias (alias PK, package_name, source builtin|manifest|admin) + the immutable builtin cinatra -> @cinatra-ai/cinatra-assistant seed (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). TABLE-EXISTENCE GUARDED: the backfill DO block RETURNs early unless assistant_handles + agent_templates + installed_extension all exist. Single all-or-nothing transaction; unqualified names resolve to the app schema on the runner's search_path. DOWN is reversible (additive): drops the two NET-NEW tables + the added columns/constraints/index. SEQ IS PROVISIONAL: assigned at merge — this migration was originally cut at 0061, then renumbered to 0063 after sibling lanes shipped core__0061 (assistant-turn-content-and-pause-state) and core__0062 (email-correlation-data-indexes) to origin/main; shipped max at renumber time is core__0062, so this is 0063; a further concurrent sibling may claim 0063 first, in which case renumber-at-merge is normal. migrations/** is HIGH-RISK: owner approval required; the lane never merges.
